title: Lawn Treatments
cardSummary: Tailored fertilization, weed management, and soil health programs designed to keep your turf lush, thick, and vibrantly green all season long.
detailsSummary: A season-long program of soil-balanced fertilization, weed control, and targeted care that turns thin, patchy turf into a lawn the whole street notices.

scopeCards.title: Soil & pH assessment
scopeCards.description: We test before we treat, so every application matches your lawn's real needs.

scopeCards.title: Custom fertilization plan
scopeCards.description: A season-long feeding schedule tuned to your grass type and climate.

scopeCards.title: Slow-release feeding
scopeCards.description: Granular and liquid nutrients that green up fast and last for weeks.

scopeCards.title: Targeted weed control
scopeCards.description: Broadleaf and crabgrass control that protects your turf, not just hits it.

scopeCards.title: Grub & insect prevention
scopeCards.description: Proactive protection against the pests that quietly destroy roots.

scopeCards.title: Free re-treatments
scopeCards.description: Not seeing results between visits? We come back at no extra charge.
